job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is a City of Hartford investment consultant RFP, not the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System RFP. Its proposal deadline is for a different issuer and does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: CITY OF HARTFORD TREASURER’S OFFICE MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT FUND of the CITY of HARTFORD and CITY of HARTFORD OPEB TRUST
Proposals shall be received no later than March 15, 2024 at 5 p.m. Eastern Time (subject to change)
